summary: Preliminary assistant desk review of a fictional product case. The documents are structurally useful, but the opportunity and architecture are not validated for implementation.

findings.title: Buyer problem and demand are unvalidated
findings.basis: No workshop-owner interviews, workflow observations, demand evidence or willingness-to-pay evidence exist in this synthetic case.
findings.next_action: For a real product, select a target market and conduct documented buyer interviews and workflow observations before making a build decision.

findings.title: Geography and competitive alternatives are not researched
findings.basis: The country and city are unspecified; paper, spreadsheets and messaging apps are scenario assumptions rather than researched alternatives.
findings.next_action: Choose a target geography, research current alternatives and competitors, and record dated sources with limitations.

findings.title: Jurisdiction-specific privacy obligations are unknown
findings.basis: Customer contact and vehicle identifiers may be personal data, but no country, legal review, retention policy or data-residency decision exists.
findings.next_action: Select the intended jurisdiction and obtain qualified privacy/compliance review before using real customer data.

findings.title: Ownership cardinality and permissions remain hypotheses
findings.basis: Multi-workshop membership and role boundaries are proposed but not validated; no executable authorization contract or tests exist.
findings.next_action: Validate the operating model, define a complete role-permission matrix and specify negative cross-workshop access tests.

findings.title: Real operating cost and free-tier feasibility are unknown
findings.basis: No vendor, hosting, database, backup, monitoring or usage scenario has been selected or costed.
findings.next_action: Compare no-cost and low-cost options using current official limits, realistic usage scenarios and migration/exit costs.

findings.title: No bounded implementation phase is justified yet
findings.basis: The discovery, jurisdiction, privacy, ownership and cost questions remain open; no implementation scope or owner approval exists.
findings.next_action: Keep implementation blocked until critical evidence and architecture decisions are resolved and the owner separately approves an exact bounded phase.
